items.title: 中国科学家领衔首次证实全新物质形态「胶球」存在
items.title_zh: 中国领衔BESIII国际合作组首次证实胶球存在
items.title_en: Chinese-led BESIII Collaboration Confirms Glueballs, New Form of Matter
items.summary: Chinese-led BESIII collaboration has for the first time confirmed the existence of glueballs, a new state of matter composed of gluons, after 15 years of research.

items.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
items.title_zh: AMD收购Taalas，将AI模型蚀刻进硅片加速推理
items.title_en: AMD acquires Taalas to etch AI models into silicon for faster inference
items.summary: AMD acquires AI chip startup Taalas to improve inference performance by etching models into silicon, sparking discussion about strategic implications for AI hardware and model evolution.

items.title: Mario Meets Pareto
items.title_zh: 马里奥赛车解释帕累托最优与权衡
items.title_en: Mario Kart Explains Pareto Optimality and Tradeoffs
items.summary: An article that uses Mario Kart to explain Pareto optimality, with community discussion on applying Pareto frontiers to game optimization and real-world tradeoffs.

items.title: Taste Is All That's Left
items.title_zh: 品味是AI辅助编程中人类最后的优势
items.title_en: Taste Is the Last Human Edge in AI-Assisted Coding
items.summary: This essay argues that in an era of AI coding assistants, human taste and judgment are the remaining qualities that differentiate skilled developers and shape good software.

items.title: Qwen3.8 Max now ranked as the best overall model by agentic index
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8 Max登顶Agentic Index，引发基准可信度讨论
items.title_en: Qwen3.8 Max Tops Agentic Index, Sparking Benchmark Trust Debate
items.summary: Qwen3.8 Max reaches top of the agentic index, prompting discussion about China's AI progress and benchmark inconsistencies.

items.title: datasette 1.0a38
items.title_zh: Datasette 1.0a38 修复混合访问数据库中的 SQL 注入漏洞
items.title_en: Datasette 1.0a38 fixes SQL injection in mixed-access databases
items.summary: Datasette 1.0a38 fixes a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow read-only access to private tables in mixed-access databases.

items.title: Round-Trip Consistency: Bidirectional Diffusion Models Can Predict Their Own Rollout Errors [R]
items.title_zh: 双向扩散模型利用往返一致性预测长程生成误差
items.title_en: Bidirectional Diffusion Model Uses Round-Trip Consistency to Predict Rollout Errors
items.summary: A bidirectional conditional latent diffusion model uses round-trip consistency as a self-supervised proxy for rollout error, improving long-horizon generation and forecasting without ground truth or ensembles.

items.title: 📱 张一鸣：字节跳动不会依赖 AI 蒸馏技术
items.title_zh: 张一鸣：不依赖AI蒸馏，优先长远目标
items.title_en: ByteDance Founder Rules Out AI Distillation, Prioritizes Long-Term Goals
items.summary: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming rules out relying on AI distillation to catch up in the model race, prioritizing long-term goals over short-term gains, partly due to US regulatory scrutiny over TikTok.

items.title: 字节跳动讨论训练超 5 万亿参数大模型
items.title_zh: 字节跳动讨论训练超5万亿参数大模型
items.title_en: ByteDance Discusses Building 5+ Trillion-Parameter AI Model
items.summary: ByteDance is reportedly planning a 5+ trillion parameter model, which would be China's largest, led by Seed Foundation's Xiang Liang.

items.title: GPT-5 发布一周年，OpenAI 推出 Agent Plugins 开放标准
items.title_zh: GPT-5一周年，OpenAI发布Agent Plugins开放标准
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Agent Plugins Open Standard on GPT-5's First Anniversary
items.summary: On GPT-5's first anniversary, OpenAI and industry partners launch Agent Plugins, an open standard for packaging agent skills and MCP servers across compatible clients.
